transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we get into the daily plan, let's sort out the receiving assignments for the four pallets arriving at 0830. We've got water-treatment chemicals, refrigerated medical cold packs, generator air filters, and battery modules coming in, and we need to get them into the right storage areas. The available spaces are the ventilated chemical shed, the medical cold room, the secure parts cage, and the covered outbound staging bay. I'd like to hear from each of you on what makes sense for your items before I approve the plan.

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag something before we finalize assignments. I checked the warehouse handling sheet this morning, and the water-treatment chemicals are confirmed corrosive — they must go to the ventilated chemical shed. I should note the revised handling sheet hasn't been attached to the receiving packet yet, so not everyone may have that visibility.
